name: mac-sonde
description: A line above the Claude Code prompt with your Mac's CPU, GPU, RAM, temperature, load and swap, each followed by a small colour sparkline (macOS only)

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the line and of the /mac command: en (English) or fr (français).

sparkline.title: Sparkline style
sparkline.description: bars ▁▃▅█ (30 s of history) · line ⣀⡠⠊ (1 min, the line alone) · filled ⣀⣤⣶⣿ (1 min, area filled). Change it later with /mac bars, /mac line or /mac filled.

temperatureFile.title: Temperature file
temperatureFile.description: Optional. Path of a file holding '<unix time in seconds> <degrees Celsius>' (for example '1762620000 58'), kept fresh by a tool of yours; ~/ is your home folder. Empty: no temperature is shown. See the README.
